summary: Master Microsoft Word with our Essentials Training Course. Learn key features and tips to enhance your productivity and create professional documents.
lede: Microsoft Word training helps office professionals create, format, and review business documents with less manual rework. Participants practice applying styles and templates, controlling page layouts, and using comments and Track Changes to manage revisions; they also work with tables, visuals, and proofing tools to prepare reports, correspondence, and other workplace documents.
audienceIntro: This course is built for office professionals who create, edit, and review documents every day and need a stronger Microsoft Word workflow.
prerequisites: You should have basic computer literacy and confidence using a keyboard, mouse, and file explorer. No coding or programming is required. A working copy of Microsoft Word desktop or Microsoft 365 Word is recommended for hands-on practice, along with access to a laptop and sample documents if available. Familiarity with opening, saving, and printing files will help you move faster, but the course starts from foundation level and progresses to intermediate document tasks.
